cases.name: roundtrip
exec_argv: import os,subprocess,sys; bb=sys.argv[1]; tmp=sys.argv[2]; comp=sys.argv[3]; os.makedirs(tmp,exist_ok=True); open(os.path.join(tmp,'rt.txt'),'wb').write(b'roundtrip payload\n'); arc=os.path.join(tmp,'rt.tar'+('.gz' if comp=='z' else '.bz2' if comp=='j' else '.xz' if comp=='J' else '.lzma' if comp=='lzma' else '')); cmd=[bb,'tar','-c','-f',arc]; cmd+= ['-'+comp] if comp else []; cmd+=['rt.txt']; subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=tmp,check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE); r=subprocess.run([bb,'tar','-t','-f',arc],cwd=tmp,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,check=True); os.remove(arc); sys.stdout.buffer.write(r.stdout)
